verses.1: Abram was ninety-five years old when God appeared to him. God said to him, “I am your God. Walk before me, and be righteous.”
verses.2: And I will make a covenant between me and you. I will bless you greatly.
verses.3: And Abraham fell to his face, and God spoke to him, saying:
verses.4: I have made a covenant with you, and you shall be the father of many nations.
verses.5: And your name will no longer be called “Avram.” Your name will remain “Avraham,” because you were given to the nations as a gift from God.
verses.6: And I have exalted you above all others. I have given you to nations and kings. From you, they will come forth.
verses.7: And I have made a covenant between me and you, and between your descendants after you. This is a covenant for ever, so that you may be God’s people, and your descendants will also be God’s people.
verses.8: And I will give you and your descendants the land that you have inherited from Canaan as a possession for ever. And I will be their God.
verses.9: And God said to Abraham, “You shall keep my covenant. You and your descendants will be my heirs.”
verses.10: This is my covenant: that you shall keep it between me and you, and between your descendants after you. All these blessings will be given to you.
verses.11: And you shall take your widows as wives; and it shall be a covenant between me and you.
verses.12: And the son of your days will tell you all about your past. He will bring forth children from within your bodies, and he will acquire wealth from all those descendants who are not from your lineage.
verses.13: May he live in your home and from your wealth. May my covenant be a bond between you forever.
verses.14: And let there be a reminder of that man who never broke his promise. Let his soul be remembered as having broken my covenant.
verses.15: And God said to Abraham, “Do not call your wife’s name ‘Sharai.’” For her name is Sharai.
verses.16: And I blessed her, and I also gave you a son from her. Bless her, and may she become the queen of nations, rulers over all peoples, from her.
verses.17: And Abraham fell on his face. He laughed, and said in his heart, “The white garment will be born after eighty years; and if a woman gives birth, she will give birth after ninety years.”
verses.18: And Abraham said to God, “Let it be done as you say. He will live before you.”
verses.19: And God said, “But your wife will give birth to a son for you. You shall call his name Isaac. I will make this covenant with him forever, as a bond of alliance between me and his descendants.”
verses.20: And as you have heard, I have blessed him, I have praised him, and I have increased his glory greatly. Two dozen kings from that land were his descendants; I gave him a great nation.
verses.21: And I will fulfill my covenant with Isaac, who will bear you a daughter on that appointed day next year.
verses.22: And he was able to speak with him. Then God descended from above Abraham’s head.
verses.23: And Abraham took Ishmael, his son, and all the descendants of his household. He also took all his possessions, along with every living being in Abraham’s household. And he made a covenant with them, in accordance with what God had spoken to him.
verses.24: And Abraham, at the age of ninety-five years, lived in his wilderness.
verses.25: And Ishmael, his son, was born at the age of thirteen years in Himmel.
verses.26: Today, Abraham and Ishmael are no longer alive.
verses.27: And all the people of his house were born in that house. They acquired their wealth from that foreign man, who was then banished from there.
